p: Deploy Hanzo AI-powered services in Docker containers. Use the Hanzo API from any containerized application with proper environment configuration.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: Apache-2.0 · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing Docker code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the Docker / Moby Project team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: FROM python:3.12-slim WORKDIR /app COPY requirements.txt . RUN pip install -r requirements.txt COPY . . ENV HANZO_API_KEY= "" ENV OPENAI_API_BASE= "https://api.hanzo.ai/v1" CMD [ "python" , "main.py" ]
services : app : build : . environment : - HANZO_API_KEY=${HANZO_API_KEY} - OPENAI_API_BASE=https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 ports : - " 8000:8000 " restart : unless-stopped
# .env file HANZO_API_KEY= your-hanzo-api-key # Start docker compose up -d # Or direct run docker run -e HANZO_API_KEY=your-key -p 8000:8000 my-ai-app
import os from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI ( base_url=os . environ . get ( " OPENAI_API_BASE " , " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " ), api_key=os . environ [ " HANZO_API_KEY " ], )
